title.en: An Act Granting Philippine Citizenship to Edwards A. Artis

title.vi: Đạo luật trao quốc tịch Philippines cho Edwards A. Artis
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติให้สัญชาติฟิลิปปินส์แก่ Edwards A. Artis
title.id: Undang-Undang memberikan kewarganegaraan Filipina kepada Edwards A. Artis

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2010/ra_10144_2010.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Edward A. Artis is hereby granted Philippine citizenship with all the rights, privileges, duties and obligations appurtenant thereto and with the same effects and subject to the same conditions as provided under the Constitution.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
